RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
[i]Recalling[/i] that [region]Syria[/region] was targeted by external aggressors, which displaced its established government and disrupted the region's community,
[i]Noting[/i] that the Security Council responded by passing Liberate Syria in order to end the occupation and restore the region to its rightful inhabitants,
[i]Observing[/i] that the conditions which justified this intervention no longer exist, as the invading forces pose no threat to Syria,
[i]Recognizing[/i] that with its purpose fulfilled, the existence of SCR#325 has long ceased providing a benefit to those it was intended to serve,
[i]Convinced[/i] that the services provided by the Security Council should serve the needs of the community and be repealed when they no longer serve those needs,
Hereby repeals SCR#325 "Liberate Syria".
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Liberate Syria"
